sources.entry: Livebook - Realtime collaborative notebook app based on Markdown that supports running Elixir code snippets, TeX and Mermaid Diagrams. Easily deployed using Docker or Elixir. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Elixir/Docker

summary.one_liner: Livebook is a web application for writing interactive, collaborative notebooks in Markdown (.livemd files) that evaluate Elixir code cells.
summary.what_it_does: Livebook provides a browser-based notebook editor with Markdown text and Elixir code cells that are evaluated on demand. It uses CodeMirror for autocompletion, inline docs and formatting, and Kino to display results such as Vega-Lite charts, tables and maps. Smart cells offer high-level tasks like querying databases or plotting charts from the UI. Notebooks are stored as .livemd files, a Markdown subset that supports Mermaid diagrams and KaTeX formulas, and multiple users can edit the same notebook at once. Code can run in a standalone Elixir instance, an attached existing node, or inside an existing Elixir project.
use_cases: documenting or introspecting existing Elixir projects
collaborative data analysis with charts and tables
sharing reproducible code notebooks as Markdown files
running Elixir code snippets in the browser
how_to_run: git clone <repo-url> && cd livebook && mix setup.prod
notable: Notebooks stored as .livemd files, a Markdown subset that plays well with version control
Real-time multi-user editing of the same notebook with no extra setup
Smart cells for automating tasks like database queries and chart plotting
Custom runtimes: standalone, attached to an existing node, or embedded in an Elixir project
Binds to 127.0.0.1 by default and uses token or password authentication
caveats: Requires Elixir v1.18 or later and specific Erlang applications when installed directly
Not officially supported as a Mix/Hex dependency; intended as a CLI tool
Anyone with access can read files and execute code on the host machine
